reports.title: Third Quarter and First Nine Months of 2026 Select Financial Highlights (compared to third quarter 2025 and first nine months of 2025 unless otherwise stated)

lines: The fourth quarter outlook for non-GAAP EPS assumes approximately 112 million fully diluted shares outstanding.
Our full year 2026 outlook for net revenue represents an increase of approximately $36 million at the assumed midpoint of our updated guidance range.
